context: Two friends chat about hobbies and entertainment
purpose: Teach: 蛍光/ボーイ/ソナタ/ネズミ/愛好/コメディ/明快/大作

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新作の蛍光ペンセット、可愛いんだよ、見て。
lines.en: Aoi, look at this — the new highlighter set just came in and it's adorable.
lines.style: Warm, eager pull forward. Quick breath before 'look.' Genuine delight that expects to be shared. Light, almost conspiratorial energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新店舗のボーイさん、礼儀正しい人ばかりよ、最近。
lines.en: Mm. The new location's staff — they've all been so polite lately.
lines.style: Soft observation, not quite there. Thinking-voice quality. A small smile underneath. Pace slightly slower, like noticing something in passing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、ベートーベンのソナタ、よく聴くの、私。
lines.en: I've been listening to a lot of Beethoven sonatas lately, actually.
lines.style: Tender, almost intimate. Slight hesitation before 'actually' — offering a small truth. Voice settles into the confession. Quiet at the edges.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の裏で、ネズミ、たまに見るのよね、気持ち悪い。
lines.en: We keep spotting mice around the back of the shop. Pretty gross, honestly.
lines.style: Dry amusement underneath. Matter-of-fact opening, then a slight grimace on 'gross.' Not complaining — just noting the absurdity. Warm enough that it lands as humor.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: バードウォッチング愛好家、最近、よく公園にいるよね。
lines.en: There've been a lot of birdwatchers in the park lately, haven't there?
lines.style: Light, conversational energy. Observant curiosity. Open-ended lift at the end — genuinely wondering if Aoi's noticed too. Engaged but not pushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日のコメディ番組、めっちゃ笑ったよ、私。
lines.en: I laughed so hard at that comedy show yesterday, I couldn't help it.
lines.style: Bright, almost self-aware about the laughter. Quick pace. A small laugh tucked underneath the words. The warmth of sharing something that made you forget yourself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日のお話、明快で、すっきりしたわよ、葵。
lines.en: That was really good, Aoi — talking with you always clears my head.
lines.style: Sincere and present. Soft warmth. Not performative. A genuine exhale. The confidence of someone who knows they're safe being honest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新作映画、大作って評判だよ、見に行こうよ、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Hey, the new movie's supposed to be amazing — let's go see it together, yeah?
lines.style: Inviting, buoyant. Forward momentum building toward the ask. That small uplift on 'let's go' that says *with you.* Genuine enthusiasm, not salesmanship.
